_doc: F-033: FunctionPatterns.runar.zig, one owner-signed stateful call per case from balance `init`. `expect` is the new `balance` in the continuation accepted by @bsv/sdk Spend.validate for the TS-compiled script (packages/runar-testing/src/__tests__/f033-zig-native-math-onchain.test.ts); FunctionPatterns_test.zig replays every case natively and must land on the same balance. `args` omit the leading Sig. `expect: "abort"`: the script rejects the spend and the native call must abort (replayed through assert_probe). `sdkRefuses`: the TS SDK cannot build that call (its interpreter throws on the zero divisor), so no spend reaches the engine; the script-level abort is pinned by the `mulDiv(1, 1, 0)` vector in packages/runar-zig/src/fixtures/f033-math-builtins-onchain.json.
